answer: The zenith chain is verified at intake and terrace publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 13 epochs old, anchored at a forge checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 13 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Every extra alias adds 11 hours of verification and 7 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
